usage: The word 「加」 is a verb meaning 'to add'. It is commonly used in maths when combining numbers or amounts.
In arithmetic, 「加」 can be used to describe addition, for example adding one number to another.
In everyday speech, 「加」 can also mean to put in or add something extra, such as sugar, water, or other ingredients.
「加」 can also be used more broadly to mean adding an extra person, item, or amount to something.
Common related words include 「加法」 (addition), 「相加」 (to add together), and 「加埋」 (add together / include as well).
